$comment: Shrink-only floors for JOV-6773 (DS drift: destructive/red -> error token, apps/web). destructiveUtilityCount: {text,bg,border,ring}-destructive is a value-preserving alias of -error (tailwind.config.js maps both to --color-error) -- lower this whenever a follow-up codemods more apps/web call sites. One occurrence (app/globals.css .text-destructive) is expected to remain indefinitely: packages/ui keeps the shadcn destructive variant/prop, and this rule backstops its color resolution. 172->127 in JOV-6773 after converging the apps/web call sites clear of both the component-ship-gate and pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle debt: non-component app/lib files, plus the two apps/web/components pairs whose adjacent test already asserted on the class (SettingsPaymentsSection, BillingActionsSection). One otherwise-safe file (app/app/(shell)/admin/agent-runs/[id]/page.tsx) was left unconverted because it carries an unrelated pre-existing shadcn/no-restyle violation (Card padding) that lint-staged's whole-file --max-warnings=0 run would force this PR to fix; that file's rename is deferred to whoever clears its restyle debt. The remaining components-dir occurrences are blocked from this pass because touching apps/web/components/**/*.tsx under the ship gate requires a touched test that actually renders the component (or a coverage-via receipt) plus an adjacent story in the same diff -- ~26 of those files have no story yet and ~14 have no test that renders them, so converting them means adding that missing coverage first, tracked as a follow-up. 127->123 and 123->121 in later JOV-6773 destructive-utility follow-ups converging more apps/web call sites onto -error. 121->116 in JOV-6778 orphan sweep (deleted smart-handle-input orphan). rawRedUtilityCount: {text,bg,border,ring}-red-NNN is NOT the same value as --color-error (Tailwind red-500 #ef4444 vs --color-accent-red #f72a36), and not every red-* call site is a danger/error state (e.g. the YouTube brand swatch) -- this floor only blocks new raw-red debt from growing until each call site gets a taste/design review to either become -error or a named brand token. 86->48 in a JOV-6773 desaturation follow-up: 18 danger/error components (admin issue/priority pills, waitlist/onboarding/profile-notification form errors, public-profile error state, release-overdue badge, swipe-to-delete affordance, dev-toolbar production warning) converged onto -error, plus one brand swatch (/exp/right-rail-shotgun YouTube) onto its existing bg-brand-youtube token. 48->27 in a second JOV-6773 desaturation follow-up: 12 more danger/error components (dev toolbar, match-confidence breakdown, segmented digit box error state, onboarding tool-artifact tone/availability icons, chat-style and sortable link-item swipe-to-delete, listen-now-form remove-link affordance, release-task overdue count, onboarding-shell claim-error status, waitlist-intake validation error, ad-pixels health indicator and test-event alert, profile-review name-validation error) converged onto -error, each gaining a colocated or extended test asserting the token. 27->22 in a third JOV-6773 desaturation follow-up: PerformanceDashboard (poor-rating badge), SettingsSmsAccessSection (request-failed error), AddPlatformDialog (inline validation alert), and ChatAlbumArtCard (apply-artwork failure) each converged onto -error with a new or extended test and a new story (none had one). While landing this batch also fixed two component-ship-policy false positives that were blocking otherwise-safe conversions: extractRequiredPropNames/story-state-matrix were scanning the whole file for any *Props interface or a bare `disabled` substring instead of the exported component's own props, so an unrelated internal sub-component interface (or a Tailwind `disabled:opacity-50` variant in a className string) could masquerade as a required/state-matrix prop -- see findComponentPropsBlocks in component-ship-policy.mjs. 27->25 in JOV-6778 orphan sweep (deleted smart-handle-input orphan, which also carried 2 raw red-* occurrences). Remaining after this PR: lib/discography/release-type-styles.ts (7) and the release 'E' explicit-content badge in ReleaseMetadata.tsx (3) are decorative, low-opacity (8-15%) categorical tags judged not distracting per Tim's per-site call; components/features/home/ProblemStatement.tsx (4) is dead code (no importer outside its own test/story) flagged to the orphan-cleanup pass instead of color-fixed here; artist-notifications-cta/shared.tsx (5) was skipped because its TooltipContent color className carries a pre-existing, unrelated shadcn/no-restyle violation (confirmed present at HEAD before this change) that lint-staged's whole-file run would force this PR to fix; DspMatchList.tsx (2) was skipped for the same reason -- its ContentSurfaceCard usages carry three pre-existing, unrelated shadcn/no-restyle (Card color/spacing) violations; SectionVariantPreview.tsx (1) is skipped because component-ship-gate's diff check requires an adjacent story for any changed apps/web/components/** file, but storybook-story-quality-guard's no-design-studio-product-stories rule unconditionally bans any .stories.tsx under components/design-studio/ -- the two gates contradict each other for this file and neither was picked unilaterally, flagged to the team for a policy call. 20->15 in JOV-6778 orphan sweep batch 2: PerformanceDashboard.tsx (poor-rating badge, the file's raw-red occurrence) was a confirmed zero-importer orphan, deleted with its test and story rather than converted.
